title: Newer AI models missed more payment fraud in Coinbase’s benchmark
content:
Coinbase reported Oct. 7 that newer versions of three major AI model families caught fewer fraudulent payments and a smaller share of fraud value in a historical test of payment screening for its Onramp service, despite an unchanged decision policy. The findings challenge the assumption that upgrading a model improves an existing payment screener.

title: Coinbase’s Texas move gets a shareholder suit dismissed over Delaware-era claims
content:
Coinbase’s move to Texas changed the rule a shareholder had to satisfy before suing its directors over alleged conduct from the company’s Delaware years. In an October 2 ruling, the Texas Business Court dismissed Gary Guillaume’s derivative action because he had not first demanded that Coinbase take action on the claims.

title: “1011”暴跌一周年：加密市场单日爆仓超190亿美元，BTC曾半小时暴跌12.7%
content: Odaily星球日报讯 2025 年 10 月 11 日加密市场遭遇历史性暴跌，全网单日清算金额超过 190 亿美元，创历史纪录。彼时比特币刚于 10 月 7 日创下 126,080 美元的历史新高，但在 10 月 11 日北京时间 16:50 左右，BTC 价格从约 116,900 美元在 30 分钟内跌至 102,000 美元，跌幅达 12.7%。暴跌期间，多家交易平台出现极端价格偏差。ATOM 在币安一度跌至 0.001 美元，而 Coinbase 最低价为 3.56 美元；币安平台上的 wBETH 一度跌至 430 美元，BNSOL 跌至 34.90 美元，USDe 跌至 0.65 美元。事件发生后，币安向受影响用户支付约 2.83 亿美元补偿。此外，链上数据显示，某 Hyperliquid 巨鲸在特朗普发布关税相关消息前完成约 4 亿美元 BTC 空头建仓，引发市场对内幕交易的猜测。Arkham 曾将其称为“特朗普内部人士巨鲸”，但相关地址关联人士 Garrett Jin 否认与特朗普存在联系，相关指控至今未获证实。
